title: Elijah and the Ravens
summary: Elijah and the Ravens follows a real Bible moment about provision. God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. When help comes in an unexpected way, Elijah's story reminds kids that God's care is not limited to normal plans.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Kings 17:1-16 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: God cared for Elijah during a drought. Ravens brought food, and later God provided through a widow's jar and jug. That is why Elijah and the Ravens is more than a fact to remember; it is a story with a choice to notice.
understand_it: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. Elijah and the Ravens also shows that provision has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: God fed Elijah through ravens during a dry and lonely season.
age_8_11_explanation: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. Ages 8-11 can follow the story by asking what pressure was present and what faithful response looked like.
teen_explanation: Elijah and the Ravens gives teens more than a simple moral. God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. The passage asks what faithful action looks like when emotions, pressure, or consequences are real.
key_truths: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.
Elijah and the Ravens shows provision through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When help comes in an unexpected way, Elijah's story reminds kids that God's care is not limited to normal plans.
life_application: When help comes in an unexpected way, Elijah's story reminds kids that God's care is not limited to normal plans.

quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points to Ravens. Remembering that answer helps the story teach provision with a real Bible detail.

quiz_questions.question: Which response best fits the lesson's point?
choices: Pretend the hard part in Elijah and the Ravens is not hard.

discussion_questions: Which person in Elijah and the Ravens had a hard choice to make?
What does Elijah and the Ravens show about God, people, or faithful living?
What part of Elijah and the Ravens would be hardest for someone your age?

activity.title: Raven Provision Drop
activity.instructions: Toss paper bread pieces into a basket and name surprising ways God can provide.

prayer_prompt: Lord, thank You for Elijah and the Ravens. Make provision more than a word I know; help it shape what I do.
